title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Named public-facing stops along the University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor from UND toward downtown Grand Forks.

cards.title: University Park
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 320 N 25th St
cards.notes: Walk over for the floral gardens, then choose a low-key activity from the trails, tennis courts, playground, or seasonal rink.
cards.short_summary: A park stop with gardens and several recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: University Park is near UND and includes trails, floral gardens, tennis courts, play equipment, a skating rink, and a spray park.
cards.source_title: University Park | Grand Forks Park District
cards.access_notes: Park amenities vary by season; check the Park District page before planning a specific activity.

cards.title: Red Pepper University
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1011 University Ave
cards.notes: Use this University Avenue counter-service stop when you want a meal break; review its current menu and ordering options before going.
cards.short_summary: A named University Avenue restaurant serving grinders and Mexican fare.
cards.evidence_claim: Red Pepper University is located at 1011 University Avenue and serves grinders and Mexican fare.
cards.source_title: Red Pepper University | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm service details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Archives Coffee House
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 3012 University Ave
cards.notes: Stop for a coffee or pastry on the University Avenue side of campus, and check the shop’s current offerings before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse at 3012 University Avenue with drinks, pastries, and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Archives Coffee House is at 3012 University Avenue and offers coffee and tea drinks, fresh-baked pastries, and sandwiches.
cards.source_title: 7 FORKS local coffee hot spots | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; verify current service before visiting.

cards.title: Empire Arts Center
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 415 DeMers Ave
cards.notes: Check the calendar for a film, concert, gallery visit, or Empire Theatre Company production before making the downtown walk.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown theater and gallery facility on DeMers Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Empire Arts Center is a circa-1919 movie house turned theater and gallery that hosts concerts, films, theater productions, and special events.
cards.source_title: Five places to discover FORKSful of cool culture | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Programs and admission conditions vary by event; consult the venue calendar.

cards.title: Fire Hall Theatre
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 412 2nd Ave N
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance at this downtown venue, then plan your route from DeMers Avenue one block north to the theater.
cards.short_summary: A 100-seat performance venue in a renovated historic fire hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fire Hall Theatre is a renovated former Number One Fire Hall with a 100-seat performance venue.
cards.source_title: Five places to discover FORKSful of cool culture | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and admission vary; check the theater schedule.

cards.title: Town Square
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; DeMers Ave & N 3rd St
cards.notes: Use the square as a downtown meetup point, then check its event listings or simply explore the play area and public gathering space.
cards.short_summary: A year-round downtown gathering place at DeMers Avenue and North 3rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Square hosts community events and festivals and includes a kids’ play area and seasonal ice-skating activity.
cards.access_notes: Events and seasonal features have separate schedules; consult the current calendar.

cards.title: Grand Forks Mural
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1 S 3rd St, Town Square
cards.notes: Pause at Town Square’s painted landmark and photograph it from the plaza; the source identifies its artists, commissioner, and 2022 installation.
cards.short_summary: A 2022 public mural at Town Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grand Forks Mural at Town Square was installed in 2022, created by Three Brushketeers, and commissioned by the Downtown Development Association and UND.
cards.source_title: Grand Forks Mural | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork at Town Square; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: Paddlewheel Sculpture
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1 S 3rd St, Town Square
cards.notes: Find the welded stainless-steel paddlewheel at the Town Square entrance and use it as a clear landmark before exploring nearby DeMers Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A stainless-steel paddlewheel sculpture marking Town Square’s entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Paddlewheel Sculpture at Town Square is a welded stainless-steel work installed in 2000 and commissioned by the City of Grand Forks.
cards.source_title: Paddlewheel Sculpture at Town Square | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork at the Town Square entrance; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: Flood Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; North 3rd St downtown
cards.notes: Add this small downtown pause while walking near Town Square; use the public art and memorial setting to reflect on the city’s flood history.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown pocket park on North 3rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Flood Memorial Park is one of the downtown pocket parks on North 3rd Street, where public art reflects local history and surroundings.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor pocket park; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: The Greenway
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; downtown Red River access
cards.notes: Continue from downtown toward the river for a walk or bike ride, and use the published map to select a trail segment that fits your time.
cards.short_summary: A 2,200-acre riverfront greenway with an all-season trail system.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenway spans 2,200 acres along the Red and Red Lake rivers and includes an all-season trail system, nature preserves, picnic sites, and camping areas.
cards.access_notes: Choose an appropriate trail segment and check conditions before biking, walking, or using river access.
